static_traits.name: Li Cheng
static_traits.family_status: Father passed away when they were 2;the rest Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has several fishing buddies,who recently noticed frustration and lack of enjoyment during fishing trips;but Li Cheng has not yet shared specific troubles with them in depth
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;no past psychotherapy experience;no history of similar psychological issues yet
static_traits.language_features: Clear thinking,concrete expression,able to review timelines and situations;fairly cooperative,with frustration and Self-doubt as the emotional tone;capable of self-Reflection and willing to try small-step changes

basic_info.main_problem: I have always believed I can never catch fish,no matter what,even though I love fishing.This belief makes me feel frustrated and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent feelings of failure and frustration have markedly affected my enjoyment of life, so I have come to seek counseling; I want to improve this situation.
growth_experiences: Father passed away at age 2,lacking a father's companionship and guidance while growing up(other family details Not mentioned).

special_situations.event: Coming home empty-handed after every fishing trip
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only catching a fish counts as success; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles down on changing bait and techniques, asks experienced fishing friends for advice to prove one can do it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not capable/I can never catch fish

special_situations.event: During fishing, there are also moments of enjoying nature and the process
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only the outcome(catching fish) has value,the pleasure in the process does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive experiences in the process, putting all attention on whether a fish is caught
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Without fish I am utterly worthless

special_situations.event: When going out with fishing buddies or talking about fishing performance,friends notice he is increasingly unhappy
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others find out I cannot catch fish,they will look down on me/think I am making a fuss over nothing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing deep sharing with friends, avoiding talking about one's own frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am exaggerating or laugh at me

special_situations.event: Still not catching fish after trying different techniques and seeking advice multiple times
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still cannot do it after exhausting all methods,it means I am inherently incapable,and will not get better in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing outing frequency,developing Withdrawal and Self-denial to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am doomed to be incapable,and will not get better in the future

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain competence and recognition through hobbies, restoring positive feelings toward life and self
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged powerless,mocked,or shamed
defense_goal: Controlling uncertainty through rational analysis and technical details,avoiding exposing vulnerability as much as possible
Reduces revealing feelings to friends to avoid judgment and shame

object_relations.object_representation: Picky others who may mock or devalue him (such as more capable fishing companions)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to review positive experiences or challenge the belief 'I can never catch fish'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to interpret the counselor's exploration as downplaying his predicament, needing him to prove himself with evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds with technical, objectifying language (listing bait, methods, time periods, etc.), tone restrained, reduces emotional expression.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests she try sharing frustration more openly with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that sharing equals admitting powerlessness,and friends will think he is making a fuss or mock him
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Postpones action on the grounds of 'what will they think of me', with a hesitant tone, emphasizing potential negative reactions to avoid trying.

manifestations: Favorite hobby loses its joy due to long returning empty-handed, feels life enjoyment has decreased
Under the value condition of 'only catching fish counts as success', the process experience is ignored
outcomes: Interest and pleasure in other life activities collaterally weakened

manifestations: Having fishing buddies but unwilling to share inner frustration in depth,worrying about being judged
Staying reserved and Self-protective in important relational situations
outcomes: Support resources not yet effectively utilized,Increased subjective sense of isolation
The negative-emotion cycle maintains; the problem persists

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes 'only catching fish counts as success' as an absolute standard to evaluate oneself
Negating the enjoyment and progress in the process

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assumes friends will think he is making a fuss or will laugh at him
Thus avoiding more open expression and help-seeking

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Self-labeling as 'I am not capable/I am a failure'
Over-worrying about others' evaluations before sharing,cautiously Suppressing expression

positive_force: Has sustained passion for and commitment to fishing
Able to proactively try multiple strategies and ask others for advice
Has some social support (several fishing friends to talk with)
Willing to try open expression and reality testing (expressed willingness to try in counseling)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as overgeneralization,negating the positive,mind reading and predicting the future
A rigid success-or-failure view with outcomes as the only standard
Self-doubt and shame,avoiding seeking help from or expressing to others
Strong dependence on external validation; easily influenced by others' evaluations
After setbacks, motivation drops rapidly, forming a cycle of avoidance and reduced participation

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Self-denial and frustration after not catching fish,leading to fewer outings or loss of interest
antecedent: Coming home empty-handed at the end of the fishing trip
Fishing at any place or time but not yet seeing any catch
Being compared or noticed when talking with others about fishing results
target_behavior.core_reason: Rigid outcome-centered beliefs(only catching fish counts as success) plus cognitive biases like overgeneralization and predicting the future,causing self-worth to be overly tied to a single outcome
target_behavior.function: Temporarily escaping failure and shame,trying to maintain self-esteem and control through Withdrawal
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood,irritability and Decreased motivation,reduced enjoyment of the hobby spilling into daily life and socializing

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding expressing real troubles and emotions to friends
antecedent: Thinking about or facing occasions of discussing fishing performance with fishing friends
When asked about recent fishing feelings and catches
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of being judged 'powerless' and shame,projecting inner worries as others' negative evaluations
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential negative evaluation and shame experiences, maintaining short-term psychological security
target_behavior.consequence: Support resources not yet activated,worsening subjective isolation and Sense of frustration,the problem cycle maintained
